module: gameplayInterface module for cargo containers (jbeam section cargoStorage): lets the GE gameplay virtually fill the containers (target volume and density) and read their state. The filling is smoothed over time and translates into node mass changes and stiffness/damping/strength changes of the beams linked to the group via jbeam functions (nodeWeightFunction, beamSpringFunction...).
usage:
-- target: 0.5 volume for container 12
gameplayInterface.executeAction(0, 5, 'setCargoContainers', {[12] = {containerId = 12, volume = 0.5, density = 1}}, 'updateExplicit')
gameplayInterface.getSystemData(0, 6, 'getCargoContainers')
notes: Action 'setCargoContainers'(data:table, mode:string): data is keyed by container id (cid), each entry must contain containerId and volume (density optional, default 1); otherwise {failReason}. mode (default 'updateExplicit'): 'updateExplicit' keeps the target of containers not mentioned; any other mode resets the unmentioned ones to volume 0/density 1; 'updateDelivery' ignores containers reserved for passengers (cargoTypes all 'passenger') and keeps their target.

Lookup 'getCargoContainers'(): returns a list (in an enclosing table) of entries {id, cargoTypes, capacity, name, groupId, partPath, nodeId, reachTargetDuration, reachTargetTimeRemaining, targetVolume, currentVolume, rateVolume, targetDensity, currentDensity}.
The container cache is built at the first call from v.data.cargoStorage, v.data.nodes and v.data.beams (via cargoGroup + partPath); it is destroyed at reset and at load.

The smoothing uses newTemporalSmoothing: volume (speed maxVolumeRate of the container, default 1000) and density (speed 2). The jbeam functions are evaluated by jbeam/expressionParser with the variables $volume and $density (smoothed values), then applied via obj:setNodeMass, setBeamSpringDamp, setBeamStrength, setBeamDeform, setBoundedBeamShortBound/LongBound, setPrecompressionRatio.
The update (updateGFX) is only active as long as a container has not reached its target: setUpdateEnabled enables/disables this extension's updateGFX hook.
Anomaly: in buildContainerCache, hasValidFunction is initialized to true and never set to false: the filter has no effect, all nodes and beams of the group are registered.
Anomaly: setUpdateEnabled(false) sets M.updateGFX to nil (not nop) before extensions.hookUpdate.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Called at load: disables the update, fills moduleActions/moduleLookups and clears the cache.

onReset.desc: Called at vehicle reset: disables the update and clears the container cache.

requestRegistration.desc: Registers the actions and lookups with gameplayInterface.

setUpdateEnabled.desc: Enables or disables this extension's updateGFX loop (with extensions.hookUpdate('updateGFX')).

enabled.desc: true to start the container smoothing.

updateGFX.desc: Called every frame during filling: advances the smoothers of each container that has not reached its target and applies masses/beam properties; disables itself when everything is at target. Is nop otherwise.
